description: This file defines database type converters for the app's data models, enabling conversion between objects and JSON strings for database storage.

methods.name: jsonFromAttachments
methods.description: Converts a list of Attachment objects to a JSON string for database storage.

methods.name: attachmentsFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into a list of Attachment objects.

methods.name: jsonFromTasks
methods.description: Converts a list of NoteTask objects to a JSON string for database storage.

methods.name: tasksFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into a list of NoteTask objects.

methods.name: jsonFromColorEnum
methods.description: Converts a NoteColor enum value into a JSON string.

methods.name: colorEnumFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into a NoteColor enum value.
